propositions: _assemble_context_uncached silently catches enumeration and per-child-fetch failures with bare except Exception, leaving children list empty and has_children returning False, which causes container-scoped DET checks to return trivial pass instead of incompleteness signal

PlanContext lacks hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail fields to track whether context assembly failed, allowing failed hierarchies to be indistinguishable from successfully-loaded empty hierarchies
finalize_verdict and drift_floor._recompute_verdict_after_drop have no logic to produce INDETERMINATE when hierarchy context was incomplete, instead falling through to PASS

hierarchy_incomplete flag must be threaded through coverage dict across five finalize_verdict call sites (plan_review_precheck, plan_review_coach, _recover_plan_review_coach_failure, _recover_plan_review_verify_failure, _degraded_plan_review_verdict), but plan_review_coach YAML with: blocks do not currently pass the fields from precheck outputs
schema plan_review_precheck_output.schema.json lacks hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail field declarations, blocking their emission and consumption by downstream recovery paths
